title: PSD Reflection Blocker Resolution

sprint34_investigation.nuget_check: Aspose.PSD latest_stable = 26.4.0 (no new version in sprint34 cycle)
sprint34_investigation.action_taken: Version monitoring confirms no advancement since sprint blocker was filed
sprint34_investigation.hypothesis: Aspose.JavaAttributes 1.0.0.0 is an internal Java interop shim used by Aspose.PSD for .NET's Java-heritage code. It is NOT available on NuGet and is unlikely to be made public.

aspose_java_attributes_assessment.name: Aspose.JavaAttributes
aspose_java_attributes_assessment.description: Used for Java-to-.NET attribute conversion in Aspose's Java-heritage products. Not distributed publicly.
aspose_java_attributes_assessment.alternative_approach: None identified — this is a fundamental dependency of the PSD product architecture

resolution_path.rationale: Aspose.PSD depends on Aspose.JavaAttributes which is a private internal assembly. No path to resolve this via NuGet. Aspose would need to either bundle this assembly within the main package or make it publicly available.

taskcard: TC-PSD-01: Escalate to Aspose PSD team — request Aspose.JavaAttributes be bundled in Aspose.PSD.nupkg or made available on NuGet
